title: A document past the 1 MiB ceiling
why: Bounded **before** parsing, for the reason the artifact reader is bounded before opening: every other budget fires after something has already been materialised unless it is checked first, and `JSON.parse` allocates the whole payload before the acceptance and raster caps can see it. A document with one enormous string and a single acceptance reaches none of them. The reader should refuse to fetch past the ceiling for the same reason `readArtifact` must; this is the defence in depth behind it.
